minizorah-opt-in-disabled.description: Limited source-backed opt-in-disabled profile, not GPU observed. Only these two MiniZorah opt-in gates are covered; this is not a complete device, capability, or GPU skip baseline. Select only when METALLIC_TEST_MINIZORAH is unset or not 1. Known skips remain skipped and do not establish runtime acceptance.

skips.name: minizorah_typed_final_blit_frames
skips.requires: METALLIC_TEST_MINIZORAH=1 and the local GPU-ready MiniZorah cache to exercise the scene
skips.source: source-backed, not GPU observed: tests/rhi/FinalBlitTests.cpp MiniZorahFinalBlitTest::run; tests/rhi/main.cpp suiteNameFor and RHIGTestAdapter map Rendering to RHIRendering and forward the exact skip reason

skips.name: minizorah_quality_audit
skips.requires: METALLIC_TEST_MINIZORAH=1 and the local GPU-ready MiniZorah cache to exercise the quality audit
skips.source: source-backed, not GPU observed: tests/rhi/MiniZorahQualityTests.cpp MiniZorahQualityAuditTest::run; tests/rhi/main.cpp suiteNameFor and RHIGTestAdapter map Validation to RHIValidation and forward the exact skip reason
